import ctypes
import os

def assert_test():
    # Load libraries in the correct order
    libgslcblas_path = '/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so'
    libgsl_path = '/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so'

    assert os.path.exists(libgslcblas_path), "libgslcblas.so not found"
    assert os.path.exists(libgsl_path), "libgsl.so not found"

    ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

    # Define the function prototype for gsl_spmatrix_alloc
    gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_void_p)

    # Test case 1: Create a sparse matrix with valid dimensions
    rows, cols = 10, 10
    spmatrix_ptr = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc(rows, cols)
    assert spmatrix_ptr is not None, "Failed to allocate sparse matrix"

    # Test case 2: Edge case with zero rows and columns (removed due to GSL restriction)

    # Test case 3: Large dimensions
    rows, cols = 1000, 1000
    spmatrix_ptr = gsl.gsl_spmatrix_alloc(rows, cols)
    assert spmatrix_ptr is not None, "Failed to allocate sparse matrix with large dimensions"

    print("All tests passed successfully.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
